source: https://www.inm.gob.mx/fmme/publico/en/solicitud.html (form HTML and its field checks in jquery.inm.fmme.solicitud and jquery.inm.common.validator, read 2026-10-15)

passport.label: Passport number
passport.help: Printed on the photo page of your passport. Letters and digits, up to 15; the FMM asks for it twice and blocks pasting.

errors.tooLong: Passport number too long — max 15 characters
errors.invalidChars: Letters and numbers only — no spaces or symbols
errors.invalidFormat: Letters and digits only, up to 15

given_name.label: Given name (Nombre)
given_name.help: Exactly as shown on your passport. The FMM accepts Latin letters with accents (é, ñ, ü), single spaces, hyphens and apostrophes, up to 100 characters.

errors.invalidChars: Letters (accents allowed), single spaces, hyphens and apostrophes only

family_name.label: Family name (Apellidos)
family_name.help: Exactly as shown on your passport. The FMM accepts Latin letters with accents (é, ñ, ü), single spaces, hyphens and apostrophes, up to 100 characters.

errors.invalidChars: Letters (accents allowed), single spaces, hyphens and apostrophes only

nationality.label: Nationality
nationality.help: ISO 3-letter country code of the country that issued your passport

errors.invalidFormat: Use the 3-letter code (e.g. USA, CAN, GBR, FRA)

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: DD/MM/YYYY, day first, as the FMM's date boxes check. It cannot be later than today.

errors.tooEarly: The FMM does not take a birth date about 110 years back or more
errors.tooLate: Date of birth cannot be later than today

arrival_date.label: Arrival date
arrival_date.help: DD/MM/YYYY — the date you enter Mexico. The FMM takes today through 29 days ahead, by the INM server's date.

errors.tooEarly: Arrival date cannot be in the past
errors.tooLate: The FMM takes arrivals up to 29 days ahead

entry_point.label: Point of entry
entry_point.help: Picked from the form's list after you choose By air or By land. Names are in Spanish, e.g. El Chaparral or Mesa De Otay for Tijuana.

trip_purpose.label: Purpose of trip
trip_purpose.help: Tourism, business, transit, study, or other

destination_address.label: Address in Mexico
destination_address.help: Where you will stay: hotel name, street and number, up to 40 characters. Letters, digits, spaces and - . , " ' only; the FMM turns it into capitals.

email.label: Email
email.help: Your FMM PDF and reference number are sent here. The FMM asks for it twice, blocks pasting, and does not accept + in the address.

errors.invalidFormat: Must look like name@example.com — letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores; no +
